title: Jasmine Thai Goose Khao Pad
description: A delicate, umami-rich Thai dish featuring crispy goose skin and tender goose meat, served in a light and aromatic jasmine-infused sauce. Perfect for a romantic date night or special occasion.

ingredients.name: Goose meat
ingredients.notes: Diced, preferably from a pasture-raised goose

ingredients.name: Soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Light or dark, depending on preference

instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of goose fat in a large wok or frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the diced goose meat and cook until browned and crispy, about 5 minutes.
Remove the cooked goose meat from the wok and set aside.
In the same wok, add the remaining 2 tbsp of goose fat and pour in the beaten egg.
Scramble the egg until cooked through, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the cooked jasmine rice to the wok and stir-fry for about 2 minutes, until heated through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the fish sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, grated ginger, and garlic.
Pour the sauce mixture over the rice and stir-fry for another 2 minutes, until well combined.
Add the cooked goose meat back into the wok and stir-fry for a final 2 minutes, until heated through and the flavors have melded together.
Serve immediately, garnished with sliced Thai chiles and fresh cilantro, if desired.
This recipe makes 2-3 servings and can be easily doubled or tripled for a larger group.
